title: HQ
statementMd:
The famous joke programming language HQ9+ has only 4 commands. In this problem we will explore its subset — a language called HQ...

## Input

The only line of the input is a string between $1$ and $10^{6}$ characters long.

## Output

Output "`Yes`" or "`No`".
